resources.string: RetroDS reads your games from your ROM folder and keeps its save states, screenshots, cheats and game logos in a \"RetroDS\" folder on your storage. Android calls the permission for that \"All files access\".\n\nOn the next screen, switch it on for RetroDS, then come back.
Without it, they stay in RetroDS\'s own folder, and Android deletes that folder, save states included, when RetroDS is uninstalled.
Save states are in RetroDS\'s own folder: uninstalling RetroDS deletes them. Allow All files access in Android\'s settings for RetroDS to keep them.
RetroDS needs \"All files access\" to read your ROM folder. Switch it on, then come back.
